title: OneMain Holdings Announces Date of First Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
summary: OneMain Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: OMF), the leader in offering nonprime consumers responsible access to credit, plans to report its first quarter 2026 results before the market opens on Friday, May 1, 2026. The earnings release will be available on OneMain's investor relations website at http://investor.onemainfinancial.com . A conference call to discuss the company's results, outlook and related matters will be held that morning at 9:00 a.m. Eastern. The general public is invited to listen to the call by dialing 800-420-1271 (U.S. domestic) or 785-424-1634 (international), and using conference ID 31259, or via a live audio webcast through our investor relations website. For those unable to listen to the live broadcast, a replay will be available on our website after the event. About OneMain Holdings, Inc. OneMain Financial (NYSE: OMF) is the leader in offering nonprime consumers responsible access to credit and is dedicated to improving the financial well-being of hardworking Americans.
